subject.title: fix(doctor): flag missing plugin install paths

question: Should `openclaw doctor --fix` remove persisted plugin install records when their primary install/source path no longer exists?
rationale: The patch is a focused bug fix with real CLI proof, but it intentionally mutates persisted plugin install state for existing users when they run doctor repair.

options.title: Accept Doctor Removal Semantics
options.body: Merge after current-head checks are refreshed, accepting that absent primary install/source paths are stale install records that doctor should remove before rebuilding the registry.

options.title: Request Broader Upgrade Proof
options.body: Ask for an additional packaged-upgrade or existing-user state proof before merging the persisted-state repair.

options.title: Keep Warning Only
options.body: Pause if maintainers prefer warning about missing install paths without removing records until a separate product decision is made.

recommendation.title: Accept Doctor Removal Semantics
recommendation.body: Merge after current-head checks are refreshed, accepting that absent primary install/source paths are stale install records that doctor should remove before rebuilding the registry.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced the doctor registry repair path and has recent persisted plugin registry history around the affected behavior.
